verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a broad first-party API (the DBX Platform) for file storage, sharing, previews, and search. It includes a Files API for create, read, edit, move, and delete, team namespace listing, scoped OAuth, webhooks, and official SDKs in several languages, plus a separate Dropbox Sign API covering the eSignature UI feature. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent; probes also found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: any documented API parity commitment, API coverage for UI features such as Dash AI search/summarization, PDF editing, password-protected links, and large file Transfers, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
